newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank repo average rate eases to 16.30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank repo average rate eases to 16.30 pct.

text.p: The average rate at a Slovak central bank (NBS) one-week repo tender on Tuesday eased to 16.30 percent from 17.43 percent in a similar repo on Monday, the NBS said in a statement.
The NBS offered 2.0 billion crowns and bids totalled 2.399 billion crowns. The minimum accepted rate was 14.80 percent, while the maximum rate was 18.00 percent.
The NBS added 4.0 billion crowns to the interbank market through a one-week repo tender on Monday, with the average rate rising to 17.43 percent from 16.50 percent in a similar repo on Friday.

According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 28 lacked 0.77 percent of funds needed to meet minimum reserve requirements. The daily volume of minimum reserves for commercial banks total 36.583 billion crowns in the current reserves period ending July 31.
